name: time is a feature
headline: *Time* is on your side
say: Reason three: time is on your side. Undo works across sessions. A rewind window lets you scrub through what a page used to look like. When you take someone's work, it arrives as a named revision, and any update they make later waits until you choose it. Snapshots let you try something risky, then come back. Because every step is kept, the past is always one signature away, and it never rots.
